structuredContent.content: #!/usr/bin/env python3 """R284EY: exact integer verification of four-label one-change model. The dynamic test checks all effective errors of Hamming weight <=u+q. Each such effective error is realizable by a persistent mask of weight <=q and an independent read mask of weight <=u; at most one change in the persistent mask suffices to realize any two selected reads. """ import itertools, json from pathlib import Path def masks(n,rad): yield 0 for j in range(1,rad+1): for comb in itertools.combinations(range(n),j): yield sum(1<>j & 1] F=sum(1<=2*v+1 checked=0 for i,ps in enumerate(paths): seen_new=False for k,p in enumerate(ps): for err in masks_all: y=p^err matches=[j for j,c in enumerate(codes) if (c^y).bit_count()<=v] assert len(matches)<=1 dec=matches[0] if matches else None assert dec in (None,i,(i+1)%4),(u,q,i,k,dec) if k==0: assert dec==i if k==len(ps)-1: assert dec==(i+1)%4 if dec==i: assert not seen_new,(u,q,i,k,err) if dec==(i+1)%4: seen_new=True checked+=1 return {"u":u,"q":q,"v":v,"n":n,"paths_prefix_states":sum(map(len,paths)),"admissible_effective_masks":len(masks_all),"exact_reads":checked,"result":"PASS"} if __name__=='__main__': cases=[test(u,q) for u in range(3) for q in range(3)] witnesses=[boundary(u,q) for u in range(3) for q in range(3)] cert={"record":"R284EY_ONE_ARBITRARY_MASK_CHANGE_4TAG", "model":"one arbitrary change F_before -> F_after between any two observations, wt(F_before),wt(F_after)<=q; each read has independent <=u flips; output unique radius-(u+q) endpoint or RETRY; writer may pause at prefixes", "result":"n_min=5*(u+q)+2 for nonnegative integers u,q; unrestricted single-change mask", "cases":cases,"sharp_edge_witnesses":witnesses, "proof_scope":"General integer proof in R284EY theorem note; finite exact checks only for u,q in {0,1,2}", "review":"NOT_REVIEWED"} p=Path('/mnt/data/R284EY_one_mask_change_certificate.json') p.write_text(json.dumps(cert,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n') print(json.dumps({"total_reads":sum(t['exact_reads'] for t in cases),"cases":cases,"certificate":str(p)},ensure_ascii=False))
